m: सं-˚लालित mfn. caressed, fondled, MW.

s: puM, (saM + lapa + GaY .) parasparaBAzaRam । ityamaraH ॥ anyonyaM prItiBAzaRaM saMlApaH । uktipratyuktiBAvena viroDarahita manyonyaBAzaRaM saMlApaH । iti pare'pi । rahasi BAzaRaM saMlApaH । iti kOmudI । miTo'nyonya rahasyapi । iti vakzyati । samantAllapanaM saMlApa priyAdikaTA GaY । yastvAlApaH sa tu kenApi kriyate । idantu parasparaBAzaRameveti BedaH । iti BarataH ॥ “uktipratyuktimadvAkyaM saMlApa iti kIrttyate .” ityujjvalanIlamaRiH ॥
v: pu॰ sam + lapa--GaY । 1 parasparakaTane amaraH । prItyA anyonyAktipratyuktiByAM 2 BAzaRe 3 rahasi kaTane ca ।
m: सं-लाप m. (ifc. f(आ). ) talking together, familiar or friendly conversation, discourse with (instr. with and without सह, or gen.) or about (comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
(in dram.) a kind of dialogue (passionless, but full of manly sentiments, e.g. Mcar. ii, 34), Bhas.
a: संलापः — 1 Conversation, chat, discourse. --2 Especially familiar or confidential talk, secret conversation. --3 (In dramas) A kind of dialogue.

k.v: अनुलापो मुहुर्भाषा विलापः परिदेवनम्. विप्रलापो विरोधोक्तिः संलापो भाषणं मिथः॥

m: सं-˚लापक m. a kind of dialogue (= prec.), Bhar.
सं-˚लापक n. a species of minor drama (said to be of a controversial kind), Sāh.
a: संलापकः — A kind of minor drama, said to be of a controversial kind; see S. D. 549.

m: सं-˚लापिन् mfn. discoursing, conversing, ib.
सं-˚लापित mfn. (fr. Caus.) spoken to, addressed, Hit.
सं-√ ली Ā. -लीयते, to cling or adhere to (acc.), MBh.; to go into, find room in (loc.), ib.; to lie down, hide, cower, lurk, be concealed, ib.; R.; to melt away, ib.
a: संली — {c4c} A. 1 To cling, adhere or stick to. --2 To lie down or settle upon, alight. --3 To lurk. --4 To melt away. --5 To go or enter into.

m: सं-लीढ mfn. licked up, licked, enjoyed, MW.
a: संलीढ — p. p. Licked up; enjoyed, tasted.

m: सं-लीन mfn. clinging or joined together, adhering or clinging to (loc.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
entered into (loc.), MBh.
hidden, concealed, cowered, cowering down, lurking in (loc.), MBh.; R.
contracted, Suśr.
a: संलीन — p. p. 1 Clung, adhered to. --2 Joined together. --3 Hidden‘ concealed. --4 Cowering down. --5 Contracted, shrunk. --Comp. --कर्ण a. with the ears hanging down. --मानस a. depressed in mind, in drooping spirits.

m: सं-लीन—कर्ण mfn. one whose ears are depressed or hang down, Pañcat.
सं-लीन—मानस mfn. drooping or depressed in mind, Hariv.
सं-√ लभ् Ā. -लभते, to take hold of one another, seize or lay hold of mutually, TBr.; to wrestle with (instr.), MaitrS.; to obtain, receive, BhP. : Desid. See लिप्सु below.
सं-√ लङ्घ् P. Ā. -लङ्घति, ˚ते, to leap over or beyond, pass by or away (see below).
सं-लङ्घन n. passing away (of time), Lāṭy., Sch.
सं-लङ्घित mfn. passed away, gone by, Lāṭy.
सं-लब्ध mfn. taken hold of, obtained, Kathās.
सं-√ लग् Caus. -लागयति, to attach to, put or place firmly upon, KātyŚr., Sch.

s: tri, saMyuktaH । saMpUrvvalagaDAtoH ktapratyayena nizpannaH ॥ yaTA, kaTAsaritsAgare । 123 । 111 । “sa cAbDivelayA nItvA viDigatyeva roDasi । kziptastaddvIpasaMlagno mahAmatsyo'vasannavAn ॥”
m: सं-लग्न mfn. closely attached, adhering, being in contact with, sticking to or in, fallen into (loc. or comp.), MBh.; Kathās.
fighting hand to hand (du. said of two combatants), MBh.
(ifc.) proceeding from or out of Pañcar.
a: संलग्न — p. p. 1 Closely attached, stuck together, united with, adhering to. --2 Come to blows or close contest.

m: सं-√ लज्ज् Ā. -लज्जते (only pr. p. -लज्जमान), to be thoroughly ashamed or embarrassed, R.

सं-√ लक्ष् P. Ā. -लक्षयति, ˚ते, to distinguish by a mark, characterize, mark distinctly (see ˚लक्षित below); to observe, see, perceive, feel, hear, learn, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to test, prove, try, ib. : Pass. -लक्ष्यते, to be marked or observed or perceived, appear, ib.
a: संलक्ष् — {c10c} U. 1 To observe, perceive, see, notice; आश्चर्यदर्शनः संलक्ष्यते मनुष्यलोकः Ś. 7; संलक्ष्यते न छिदुरोपि हारः R. 16. 62 ‘is not noticed or known’; 8. 42. --2 To test, prove, determine; हेम्नः संलक्ष्यते ह्यग्नौ विशुद्धिः श्यामिकापि वा R. 1. 10. --3 To hear, learn, understand. --4 To characterize, distinguish.

m: सं-लक्षण n. the act of distinctly marking, distinguishing, characterizing, W.
सं-˚लक्षित mfn. distinguished by a mark, marked, Pañcar.
observed, recognized, known, perceived, learnt, Kāv.; Kathās.
सं-˚लक्ष्य mfn. to be distinctly marked, distinguishable, perceptible, visible, Kpr.
सं-√ लल् Caus. -लालयति√ to caress, fondle, treat tenderly, BhP.
सं-√ लप् P. -लपति, to talk together, chat, converse, Daś.; HPariś. : Pass. -लप्यते, to be spoken of or to, be called or named, Sarvad. : Caus. See ˚लापित below.
a: संलप् — {c1c} P. 1 To talk, converse; संलपतो जनसमाजात् Dk. --2 To name, call.

m: सं-लपन n. the act of talking or chattering together
सं-लप˚नोष्णता f. desire of talking much, Suśr.
सं-लप्तक mfn. affable, gentle, civil, Buddh.

s: puM, (saM + lI + ac .) nidrA । iti hemacandraH ॥ pralayaSca ॥
v: pu॰ saMlIyate indriyavyApAro'tra sam + lI--ADAre ac । 1 nidrAyAM hemaca॰ । BAve ac । 2 pralaye ca ।
m: सं-लय , ˚यन. See सं-√ ली.
सं-लय m. settling or sitting down, alighting or settling (of a bird), ŚBr.
sleep, L.
melting away, dissolution (= प्र-लय), MW.
a: संलयः — 1 Lying down, sleep. --2 Dissolution. --3 Universal destruction (प्रलय).

m: सं-˚लयन n. sitting or lying down, Cat.
the act of clinging or adhering to, MW.
dissolution, ib.
a: संलयनं — 1 Adhering or clinging to. --2 Dissolution. --3 Lying down, sleep.

m: सं-लेख m. strict abstinence, Buddh.
सं-लेप m. mud, dirt, Hcat.
सं-√ लिख् P. -लिखति, to scratch, scarify, Suśr.; to write, engrave, inscribe, Pañcar.; to touch, strike, play upon (a musical instrument), Lāṭy.
a: संलिख् — {c6c} P. 1 To scratch, scrape. --2 To write, inscribe. --3 To play upon (a musical instrument).

m: सं-˚लिखित mfn. scratched &c. (used in AV. vii, 50, 5 to express some act in gambling).
सं-√ लिह् (cf. सं-√ रिह्) P. -लेढि, -लिहति (pr. p. Ā. -लिहान), to lick up, devour, enjoy, Kāṭh.; MBh.; Bhaṭṭ.
सं-लिप्सु mfn. (fr. Desid.) desirous of seizing or taking hold of MBh.
सं-√ लोक् Ā. -लोकते, to look together, look at each other (with उभयतः), AitBr.
सं-लोकिन् mfn. being in view of others, observed by others, Gobh.
सं-लोडन mfn. disturbing, throwing into confusion (comp.), MBh.
सं-लोडन n. the act of disturbing or agitating or confusing, MW.

सं-√ लुभ् P. -लुभ्यति, to be perplexed or disturbed, fall into confusion, ŚBr. : Caus. लोभयति, to disarrange, throw into confusion, mix up, Lāṭy.; to efface, obliterate, AV.; to allure, entice, seduce, MBh.; R.
सं-लुलित mfn. (√ लुल्) agitated, disordered, confused, R.
come into contact with (comp.), Caurap. (‘smeared with’ Sch.)
सं-√ लुप् P. -लुम्पति, -लुप्यति, to rend or tear to pieces, tear away, pull away, AV.; ŚBr. : Caus. -लोपयति, to destroy, efface, MBh.
सं-√ लुड् Caus. -लोडयति, to stir about, move to and fro, MBh.; to disarrange, disturb, throw into disorder or confusion, ib. : Pass. -लोड्यते, to be disturbed or destroyed, ib.
a: संलुड् — {c1c} P. To stir, agitate. {c10c} U. or Caus. 1 To shake, stir about, move to and fro. --2 To confound, disturb, perplex.
